_note: portal-citizen-writes-on-the-case (dossiq#3152), design D2 and D3. What portaliq's case screen reads and writes on a dossiq case, in exactly the shapes of portaliq's portalCaseType and portalCase schemas (portaliq development 4176916, lib/Settings/portaliq_register.json). The case type decides what a resident may change and until when; a case type that declares none of these offers nothing, because portaliq reads an absent window as closed. portalWrites and portalDocuments are portaliq's record of what a resident changed and added. They are NOT readOnly: OpenRegister refuses an update that changes a readOnly property (ValidateObject::validateReadOnlyConstraints), and portaliq appends to them on every update.
